title: Old San Juan Townhouse
description: This 19th-century townhouse required treatments that respected its architectural heritage while meeting modern comfort standards. Restoration-appropriate interior shutters were custom-milled to match original profiles, paired with hand-sewn roman shades in a muted sage linen that echoes the building's historic palette. The project required close coordination with heritage consultants to ensure every installation was reversible and non-invasive.
